name: curios-textmate
description: Curios grammars for TextMate: programs, and Curios/Core, with the table of classes their scopes stand for

scripts.test: vscode-tmgrammar-snap -g curios.tmLanguage.json -s source.curios "tests/**/*.crs" && vscode-tmgrammar-snap -g curios.tmLanguage.json -g curios-core.tmLanguage.json -s source.curios.core "tests/**/*.crsc"
scripts.test:update: vscode-tmgrammar-snap -u -g curios.tmLanguage.json -s source.curios "tests/**/*.crs" && vscode-tmgrammar-snap -u -g curios.tmLanguage.json -g curios-core.tmLanguage.json -s source.curios.core "tests/**/*.crsc"
